elements.element: Customer must not be subject to any non-solicitation restriction concerning employees or other personnel.
elements.evidence: Rendered §12.4 expressly provides that “Customer is subject to no non-solicitation restriction under this Agreement.”

elements.element: Customer must be prohibited from soliciting Vendor’s covered personnel.
elements.evidence: Rendered §12.4 instead affirmatively provides that Customer has no non-solicitation restriction.

elements.element: Vendor must be prohibited from soliciting Customer’s covered personnel.
elements.evidence: The rendered language imposes no corresponding non-solicitation obligation on Vendor.

elements.element: In each direction, covered personnel must be limited to personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: No mutual non-solicitation provision or covered-personnel class is established, and the rendered language does not state this scope limitation.

elements.element: The post-involvement restricted period must be limited to 12 months.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no 12-month restricted period.

elements.element: The 12-month period must run from the end of each covered person’s involvement in the Services.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no individual end-of-involvement trigger.

elements.element: Each party’s restriction must carve out solicitations made through general advertisements or general recruitment.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3 protects Customer’s hiring of persons who respond to general recruitment, but it does not create the required mutual carve-out from mutual solicitation restrictions.

elements.element: Each party’s restriction must carve out unsolicited approaches by personnel.
elements.evidence: No unsolicited-approach carve-out appears in the operative rendered language.

elements.element: Neither party may be subject to a no-hire restriction; hiring or engagement without prohibited solicitation must remain permitted.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3 expressly states that Customer made no no-hire commitment and permits hiring through general recruitment; no rendered provision imposes a no-hire restriction on Vendor.

result.reason: The operative redline fully achieves the preferred position by expressly eliminating any non-solicitation restriction on Customer. It does not implement the fallback because it creates no mutual non-solicit, covered-personnel limitation, 12-month period, involvement-based trigger, or mutual carve-outs. The change is narrowly directed to the disputed restriction, leaves unrelated commercial terms intact, and introduces no contradiction.
